audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads [Trundle, Trundle, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill] on both layers; packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Trundle] at 54.02%. The page's own whys agree with the packet at every row: whys[0] 'neither of you has a real all-in yet', whys[1] 'come out in your favour', whys[3] 'he has to hug minions all lane', whys[6] 'he reclaims it, so end before 2+ items'. The header also contradicts itself — diff FAV with a red tone, 7/10 and a 'Hard matchup' rating line.
audit.why: Trundle's Chomp saps Attack Damage, which does almost nothing to a magic-damage champion, so from level 2 through first item Mordekaiser owns the trade; the lane only turns once Subjugate plus tank items out-sustain his flat scaling.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through First item Mordekaiser, 2+ items Trundle. Matched pairs with ratings; header brought to FAV / green / 5-6 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: No ultimate cooldowns anywhere, and the page implies you can simply 'commit on Subjugate's cooldown' as though yours came back first.
audit.why: Restating the mirror from this side: Realm of Death is 140/120/100 against Subjugate's 120/100/80, so HIS ultimate is back roughly twenty seconds sooner at every rank. That is the opposite of what a reader would assume from a page built around baiting his R.
audit.corrected: Subjugate 120/100/80s vs Realm of Death 140/120/100s — his is back sooner, so the bait has to be worth it. Chomp 3.5s, Frozen Domain 18-14s, Pillar of Ice 21-15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributes Trundle's crowd sustain to the wrong ability, in four places. spikes[1].text says Subjugate 'heals more the more enemies are around it', whys[4] says 'his Subjugate has almost no nearby enemies to heal off', mid and wants.you[2] repeat it. Riot's text for Subjugate is a single-target steal: 'immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance', doubled over 4 seconds. The crowd healing is King's Tribute (P) — 'When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.' Separately, Chomp is an auto-attack reset (the wind-up is the tell, not the cast) and that is never stated.
audit.why: The isolation advice is right but the reason given is wrong, and a reader who believes Subjugate scales with nearby enemies will misplay every teamfight — the actual conclusion (deny him a wave to leech off) comes from the passive, not the ultimate.
audit.corrected: King's Tribute heals him off enemy units dying near him — that is the crowd sustain the Realm removes. Subjugate is a single-target health/armour/MR steal on 120/100/80s that doubles over 4s. Chomp is a flat 3.5s auto-attack reset that saps Attack Damage.

audit.why: The packet's suspectName on wants.you[2] — 'Use Realm of Death' — is a FALSE POSITIVE; Realm of Death is Mordekaiser's own correct ability name and the checker matched the preceding word.
audit.corrected: No name change. I did edit that field, but for the King's Tribute correction, not the name.

notes: The important correction is a mechanic the page had attributed to the wrong ability in four separate fields: Subjugate does NOT heal more with more enemies nearby — it is a single-target health/armour/MR steal that doubles over 4s. The crowd sustain is King's Tribute, which heals him when enemy units die near him. The page's conclusion (isolate him with the Realm) survives, but it now rests on the real mechanic. Also worth the user knowing: Subjugate is 120/100/80 against Realm of Death's 140/120/100, so his ultimate returns about twenty seconds sooner at every rank — the whole page is built on 'bait his R and then commit', which is a worse deal than it reads. I stated the numbers rather than rewriting that strategy wholesale. Header was internally inconsistent (FAV + red + 'Hard matchup') and is now coherent. The packet's suspectName is a false positive. Recurring kit bug unchanged: Obliterate's grounding flag is unsupported by Riot's text and nothing was written from it.
